sarah_condition: Sarah feels well during routine Mars transit.
charm_assessment: Stable compared with her personal baseline; no rhythm concern.
required_checks: Routine vital-sign monitoring; review established baseline.
equipment: Wearable vital-sign sensor; ECG baseline record if available.

sarah_condition: Sarah notices brief fluttering in her chest while at rest.
symptoms: Brief palpitations; no dizziness, chest pain, or breathlessness.
charm_assessment: Possible rhythm irregularity. Signal artifact or a benign cause remains possible; do not diagnose from pulse data.
alert_basis: Symptoms + irregular pulse screening; confirmation required
required_checks: Repeat resting HR and BP; confirm signal quality; ask about symptoms; request ECG recording if pattern recurs.
immediate_action_steps: Pause exertion, rest, repeat measurements, record onset and symptoms.
equipment: Wearable; BP cuff; ECG-capable device if available.
treatment_guidance: No arrhythmia treatment from wearable alert alone.

sarah_condition: Palpitations persist; Sarah feels mildly lightheaded.
symptoms: Persistent palpitations; mild lightheadedness; alert and responsive.
ecg_status: ECG requested; no clinician-confirmed diagnosis yet
charm_assessment: Persistent symptomatic tachycardia with irregular pulse raises concern for a clinically important arrhythmia.
alert_basis: Repeated irregularity + palpitations + increased resting HR
required_checks: Obtain quality ECG/rhythm strip; repeat BP, HR, SpO2 and symptom assessment; check for urgent warning signs.
laboratory_tests: Electrolytes and glucose only if clinically indicated and onboard testing is available.
immediate_action_steps: Notify Crew Medical Officer; stop exertion; continue reassessment; document rhythm observations.
equipment: ECG-capable monitor; BP cuff; pulse oximeter; onboard analyzer if available.
treatment_guidance: Follow approved assessment protocol; no automated drug selection.

sarah_condition: Crew Medical Officer reviews a simulated ECG compatible with atrial fibrillation.
symptoms: Ongoing palpitations; mild dizziness; awake and communicating.
ecg_status: Simulated ECG reviewed by Crew Medical Officer: atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response
charm_assessment: Clinician-reviewed ECG supports AF in this fictional case. Requires continued evaluation and close monitoring; no automatic diagnosis by CHARM.
alert_basis: Clinician-reviewed simulated ECG + symptoms; stable enough for reassessment
required_checks: Confirm ECG interpretation; reassess circulation, BP, symptoms, and mental status; review onset history.
laboratory_tests: Electrolytes, kidney function and other tests only if indicated and available.
immediate_action_steps: Medical officer directs evaluation; keep Sarah at rest; begin continuous rhythm and vital-sign monitoring; review approved protocol.
equipment: ECG/rhythm monitor; BP cuff; pulse oximeter; local protocol access.
treatment_guidance: Only clinician-authorized care per onboard protocol; CHARM does not select medicines or dosing.

sarah_condition: Sarah becomes very dizzy and cannot continue her tasks.
symptoms: Severe lightheadedness; marked weakness; difficulty remaining upright; responsive.
ecg_status: Previously reviewed AF pattern; continuing abnormal rhythm on simulated monitor
alert_title: CRITICAL – Unstable Rhythm / Low Blood Pressure
charm_assessment: Rapid arrhythmia with hypotension and severe symptoms: possible hemodynamic instability requiring immediate emergency assessment.
alert_basis: Hypotension + severe symptoms + rapid abnormal rhythm, not heart rate alone
required_checks: Immediate airway, breathing and circulation assessment by trained crew; reassess consciousness, BP, HR, rhythm and SpO2 continuously.
laboratory_tests: Do not delay emergency assessment for laboratory testing; use available results as appropriate.
immediate_action_steps: Alert responding crew and Crew Medical Officer; activate approved onboard tachyarrhythmia emergency protocol; document events.
equipment: ECG/vital-sign monitor; BP monitor; emergency medical equipment specified by mission protocol.
treatment_guidance: Emergency rhythm care only by appropriately trained crew under approved protocol; CHARM never selects drugs or procedural settings.

sarah_condition: Ground medical communication becomes temporarily unavailable during the critical event.
symptoms: Continuing critical episode; no new symptom assessment supplied for this stage.
ecg_status: Monitoring continues locally; no new numeric ECG data or vital-sign snapshot supplied
alert_title: Earth Link Unavailable – Onboard Emergency Protocol Active
charm_assessment: Communication outage does not interrupt onboard assessment or the approved emergency protocol. No new values are invented.
alert_basis: Critical stage persists; loss of Earth link is a communication state, not a new diagnosis
required_checks: Continue local rhythm and vital-sign monitoring; preserve timestamps and mark stale values clearly.
laboratory_tests: Use results already available onboard; do not invent laboratory findings.
immediate_action_steps: Open cached approved emergency protocol; continue clinician/crew-led reassessment; log actions for later synchronization.
equipment: Local CHARM device; onboard monitoring equipment; cached approved protocols.
treatment_guidance: Continue only care authorized by the mission protocol and trained medical officer.
last_known_measurements_note: Stage 5 (last recorded): HR 162 bpm, BP 88/56 mmHg, RR 26/min, SpO2 95%. DISPLAY AS LAST KNOWN ONLY.

sarah_condition: Sarah feels less dizzy after treatment directed under the approved onboard protocol.
symptoms: Palpitations and dizziness improving; residual fatigue.
ecg_status: Follow-up ECG review pending; specific rhythm not asserted
charm_assessment: Blood pressure and heart rate improve, but recurrence and residual arrhythmia remain possible.
alert_basis: Improved BP and rate, but rhythm requires reassessment
required_checks: Repeat ECG/rhythm strip and full vital signs; reassess symptoms and mental status.
laboratory_tests: Repeat relevant tests only if clinically indicated and available.
immediate_action_steps: Continue observation; document response; maintain planned follow-up; no immediate return to duty.
equipment: ECG monitor; BP cuff; pulse oximeter; CHARM tablet.
treatment_guidance: Continue clinician-directed plan; do not infer safe discharge from one improved reading.

sarah_condition: Sarah feels well again following ongoing medical assessment.
symptoms: Palpitations and dizziness resolved; medical follow-up still required.
ecg_status: Follow-up simulated ECG reviewed by medical officer: sinus rhythm
charm_assessment: Symptoms and measurements return near baseline; episode resolved in this simulated case, without automatic medical clearance.
alert_basis: Clinician-reviewed follow-up ECG + sustained symptom improvement
required_checks: Scheduled rhythm review, symptom check and follow-up vital signs.
laboratory_tests: Further tests only if clinically indicated.
immediate_action_steps: Complete event report; review possible causes and recurrence risk; return to duty only after medical clearance.
equipment: Routine wearable; ECG equipment for follow-up if required.
treatment_guidance: Continue or complete the medical officer-approved plan as directed.
